reservations_cancelled_state_check.name: reservations_cancelled_state_check
reservations_cancelled_state_check.value: ("reservations"."status" = 'confirmed' and "reservations"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("reservations"."status" = 'cancelled' and "reservations"."cancelled_at" is not null)

waitlist_entries_state_check.name: waitlist_entries_state_check
waitlist_entries_state_check.value: ("waitlist_entries"."status" = 'waiting' and "waitlist_entries"."promoted_at" is null and "waitlist_entries"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("waitlist_entries"."status" = 'promoted' and "waitlist_entries"."promoted_at" is not null and "waitlist_entries"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("waitlist_entries"."status" = 'cancelled' and "waitlist_entries"."promoted_at" is null and "waitlist_entries"."cancelled_at" is not null)

support_message.name: support_message
support_message.default: 'V případě potíží kontaktujte organizační tým BYZON.'

operational_export_requests_range_check.name: operational_export_requests_range_check
operational_export_requests_range_check.value: "operational_export_requests"."range_from" is null or "operational_export_requests"."range_to" is null or "operational_export_requests"."range_to" >= "operational_export_requests"."range_from"

operational_export_requests_content_chec.name: operational_export_requests_content_check
operational_export_requests_content_chec.value: ("operational_export_requests"."state" = 'ready' and "operational_export_requests"."content_type" is not null and "operational_export_requests"."content" is not null and "operational_export_requests"."checksum_sha256" is not null) or ("operational_export_requests"."state" <> 'ready' and "operational_export_requests"."content_type" is null and "operational_export_requests"."content" is null)

announcements_audience_session_check.name: announcements_audience_session_check
announcements_audience_session_check.value: ("announcements"."audience_kind" = 'event' and "announcements"."session_id" is null and "announcements"."session_title" is null) or ("announcements"."audience_kind" = 'session' and "announcements"."session_id" is not null and "announcements"."session_title" is not null)

ratings_target_consistency_check.name: ratings_target_consistency_check
ratings_target_consistency_check.value: ("ratings"."target_type" = 'event' and "ratings"."session_id" is null) or ("ratings"."target_type" = 'session' and "ratings"."session_id" is not null)

ratings_comment_length_check.name: ratings_comment_length_check
ratings_comment_length_check.value: "ratings"."comment" is null or char_length("ratings"."comment") between 1 and 2000

assets_ready_metadata_check.name: assets_ready_metadata_check
assets_ready_metadata_check.value: "assets"."status" <> 'ready' or ("assets"."sniffed_mime_type" is not null and "assets"."size_bytes" is not null and "assets"."checksum_sha256" is not null)

sessions_capacity_policy_check.name: sessions_capacity_policy_check
sessions_capacity_policy_check.value: ("sessions"."capacity_mode" = 'none' and "sessions"."capacity" is null) or ("sessions"."capacity_mode" <> 'none' and "sessions"."capacity" is not null and "sessions"."capacity" > 0)

sessions_reservation_window_check.name: sessions_reservation_window_check
sessions_reservation_window_check.value: "sessions"."reservation_opens_at" is null or "sessions"."reservation_closes_at" is null or "sessions"."reservation_closes_at" > "sessions"."reservation_opens_at"

sessions_waitlist_ttl_check.name: sessions_waitlist_ttl_check
sessions_waitlist_ttl_check.value: ("sessions"."waitlist_mode" = 'offer_with_deadline' and "sessions"."waitlist_offer_ttl_minutes" is not null and "sessions"."waitlist_offer_ttl_minutes" > 0) or ("sessions"."waitlist_mode" <> 'offer_with_deadline' and "sessions"."waitlist_offer_ttl_minutes" is null)

check_ins_undo_consistency_check.name: check_ins_undo_consistency_check
check_ins_undo_consistency_check.value: ("check_ins"."undone_at" is null and "check_ins"."undone_by" is null and "check_ins"."undo_reason" is null) or ("check_ins"."undone_at" is not null and "check_ins"."undone_by" is not null and char_length("check_ins"."undo_reason") between 8 and 240)

privacy_requests_resolution_check.name: privacy_requests_resolution_check
privacy_requests_resolution_check.value: ("privacy_requests"."status" = 'pending' AND "privacy_requests"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "privacy_requests"."support_reference" IS NULL) OR ("privacy_requests"."status" = 'completed' AND "privacy_requests"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy_requests"."support_reference" IS NULL) OR ("privacy_requests"."status" = 'rejected' AND "privacy_requests"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy_requests"."support_reference" IS NOT NULL)

ticket_claim_attempts_hashes_check.name: ticket_claim_attempts_hashes_check
ticket_claim_attempts_hashes_check.value: "ticket_claim_attempts"."code_bucket_hmac" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and ("ticket_claim_attempts"."actor_hash" is null or "ticket_claim_attempts"."actor_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and "ticket_claim_attempts"."ip_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "ticket_claim_attempts"."user_agent_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'

tickets_claim_state_check.name: tickets_claim_state_check
tickets_claim_state_check.value: ("tickets"."status" = 'activated' and "tickets"."holder_user_id" is not null and "tickets"."claimed_at" is not null) or "tickets"."status" <> 'activated'
